description: This file defines a set of functions and variables for marking up test script output for GitHub workflows, including functions for starting test output, finalizing test cases, and handling output formatting with GitHub-specific annotations.

methods.name: start_test_output
methods.description: Initializes output for a test, ensuring the necessary output file exists and setting up markup output.

methods.name: finalize_test_case_output
methods.description: Finalizes the output for a test case, logging failure, fixed, or informational messages with GitHub annotations.
